displayName: 意大利（费里西安诺·瓦尔加斯） Italy (Feliciano Vargas)
description: Unofficial fan art of Italy (Feliciano Vargas) from Hetalia. A fully clothed friendly companion with pasta-twirling, flower-sketchbook presentation, a light dance and bow, careful pasta recovery, attentive book-holding, a small hop, and articulated running. Simplified neutral blue outfit without real-world military insignia. Original animation choreography; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
